# Logic reference

Every logic node (78 in all), grouped as in the Logic workspace palette. Each entry shows the node's title, its type name, what it does, its pins and inline settings, and how it reads in the Code view.

## Events

### On start

`event.onStart` · event

Runs once when play starts.

- Code: `on("start", (e) => { … });`

### On enter zone

`event.onEnterZone` · event

Runs when the hero walks into the zone.

- Settings: Zone (zone)
- Outputs: who (entity)
- Code: `on("enterZone", { zone: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On exit zone

`event.onExitZone` · event

Runs when the hero leaves the zone.

- Settings: Zone (zone)
- Outputs: who (entity)
- Code: `on("exitZone", { zone: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On interact

`event.onInteract` · event

Runs when the hero presses E at an asset’s socket. Leave the asset empty to react to every asset.

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity), socket (string)
- Code: `on("interact", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On smash

`event.onSmash` · event

Runs when an object is smashed in play (an asset, or any object when the asset is empty).

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity), bricks (number)
- Code: `on("smash", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On rebuild finished

`event.onRebuildFinished` · event

Runs when the hero finishes rebuilding a smashed object.

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity)
- Code: `on("rebuildFinished", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On variable changed

`event.onVarChanged` · event

Runs after a run that changed the variable.

- Settings: Variable (var)
- Outputs: value (any)
- Code: `on("varChanged", { var: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On timer

`event.onTimer` · event

Runs after the given seconds of play; repeats when Repeat is on.

- Settings: Seconds (number), Repeat (bool)
- Code: `on("timer", { seconds: …, repeat: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On cinematic done

`event.onCinematicDone` · event

Runs when the cinematic finishes.

- Settings: Cinematic (cinematic)
- Code: `on("cinematicDone", { cinematic: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On screen button

`event.onScreenButton` · event

Runs when a button on a screen is pressed.

- Settings: Screen (screen), Button (string)
- Code: `on("screenButton", { screen: …, button: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On custom event

`event.onCustom` · event

Runs when Send event (or an asset interaction) sends this event name.

- Settings: Event name (event)
- Code: `on("custom", { event: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On damaged

`event.onDamaged` · event

Runs when something with health is hurt and still has some left: the hero, a neighbour that can be harmed, or an object with health.

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity), amount (number), hp left (number)
- Code: `on("damaged", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On defeated

`event.onDefeated` · event

Runs when something with health reaches zero (after it breaks, drops its item and sends its event).

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity)
- Code: `on("defeated", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On locked on

`event.onLockedOn` · event

Runs when the hero locks on (Z or Tab) to something: a neighbour, an object with health, or an asset with “Can be locked on” (a switch or target in a puzzle). Target is what was locked on to.

- Settings: Asset (asset, optional)
- Outputs: target (entity)
- Code: `on("lockedOn", { asset: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On achievement

`event.onAchievement` · event

Runs when the player unlocks an achievement (empty: any of them).

- Settings: Achievement id (string, optional)
- Code: `on("achievement", { achievement: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On choice made

`event.onChoice` · event

Runs when the player picks an option in a conversation (empty: any conversation; option: only when the option has this text).

- Settings: Conversation (dialogue, optional), Option text (string, optional)
- Code: `on("choice", { conversation: …, option: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On conversation end

`event.onConversationEnd` · event

Runs when a conversation ends (empty: any conversation): the last line was read, a choice led to the end, or the hero walked away.

- Settings: Conversation (dialogue, optional)
- Code: `on("conversationEnd", { conversation: … }, (e) => { … });`

### On level up

`event.onLevelUp` · event

Runs when the hero reaches a new level (Give experience).

- Outputs: level (number)
- Code: `on("levelUp", (e) => { … });`

## Flow

### Branch

`flow.branch` · flow

Goes on through True when the condition holds, otherwise through False.

- Inputs: cond (bool)
- Flow outputs: true, false
- Code: `if (cond) { … } else { … }`

### Sequence

`flow.sequence` · flow

Runs First, then Second, then Third.

- Flow outputs: First, Second, Third
- Code: `(no keyword: the a chain is written first, then the b chain)`

### Wait

`flow.wait` · flow

Pauses this run for some seconds of game time, then goes on.

- Inputs: seconds (number)
- Code: `await wait(seconds);`

### Once

`flow.once` · flow

Lets execution through the first time only (per play).

- Code: `once(() => { … });`

### For each in zone

`flow.forEachInZone` · flow

Runs Body once for each thing inside the zone (the hero and placed assets), then Done.

- Settings: Zone (zone)
- Outputs: item (entity)
- Flow outputs: Body, Done
- Code: `forEachInZone("zone", (who) => { … });`

### Gate

`flow.gate` · flow

Lets execution through only while open. Open and Close change it; gates with the same name share one state.

- Settings: Name (string), Starts open (bool)
- Code: `gate("name", startOpen, () => { … }); gate.open("name"); gate.close("name");`

## Variables

### Get variable

`var.get` · pure

The current value of a game variable.

- Settings: Variable (var)
- Outputs: value (any)
- Code: `vars.name`

### Set variable

`var.set` · action

Gives a game variable a new value.

- Settings: Variable (var)
- Inputs: value (any)
- Code: `vars.name = value;`

### Add to variable

`var.add` · action

Adds an amount to a number variable (use a negative amount to subtract).

- Settings: Variable (var)
- Inputs: amount (number)
- Code: `vars.name += amount;`

## Math

### Add

`math.add` · pure

Adds two numbers: a + b.

- Inputs: a (number), b (number)
- Outputs: out (number)
- Code: `(a + b)`

### Subtract

`math.sub` · pure

Subtracts b from a: a − b.

- Inputs: a (number), b (number)
- Outputs: out (number)
- Code: `(a - b)`

### Multiply

`math.mul` · pure

Multiplies two numbers: a × b.

- Inputs: a (number), b (number)
- Outputs: out (number)
- Code: `(a * b)`

### Random number

`math.random` · pure

A whole number from Min to Max (both included).

- Inputs: min (number), max (number)
- Outputs: out (number)
- Code: `random(min, max)`

## Compare

### At least

`compare.gte` · pure

True when a ≥ b.

- Inputs: a (any), b (any)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a >= b)`

### At most

`compare.lte` · pure

True when a ≤ b.

- Inputs: a (any), b (any)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a <= b)`

### Equals

`compare.eq` · pure

True when a and b are the same.

- Inputs: a (any), b (any)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a === b)`

### And

`compare.and` · pure

True when both are true.

- Inputs: a (bool), b (bool)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a && b)`

### Or

`compare.or` · pure

True when either is true.

- Inputs: a (bool), b (bool)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `(a || b)`

### Not

`compare.not` · pure

True when the input is false.

- Inputs: a (bool)
- Outputs: out (bool)
- Code: `!a`

## World

### Spawn asset

`world.spawn` · action

Puts a copy of an asset at a spawn point of the current map.

- Settings: Asset (asset), At spawn (spawn)
- Outputs: entity (entity)
- Code: `world.spawn(asset, at);`

### Spawn item at object

`world.spawnNear` · action

Puts a copy of an asset at an object’s item spot (a chest’s inside, a table’s top), turned like the object. Item: the asset’s name or id, so a variable can choose it. Object: a placed asset’s id or its name (the copy nearest the hero). Its output is the new copy, for Set state.

- Inputs: item (string), object (entity)
- Outputs: entity (entity)
- Code: `world.spawnNear(item, near);`

### Remove

`world.despawn` · action

Removes a placed asset from the world for this play (an id, or an asset name: the copy nearest the hero).

- Inputs: target (entity)
- Code: `world.despawn(target);`

### Set state

`world.setState` · action

Switches a placed asset to one of its states (a chest open, a lamp off). Target: an id, or an asset name (the copy nearest the hero). Moving parts ease to the new state.

- Inputs: target (entity), state (string)
- Code: `world.setState(target, state);`

### Teleport hero

`world.teleport` · action

Moves the hero to a spawn point on this map.

- Settings: Spawn (spawn)
- Code: `world.teleport(spawn);`

### Travel

`world.travel` · action

Takes the hero to another map, at one of its spawn points.

- Settings: Map (map), Spawn (spawn)
- Code: `world.travel(map, spawn);`

### Give item

`world.give` · action

Adds items to the hero’s inventory.

- Inputs: item (string), count (number)
- Code: `world.give(item, count);`

## Audio

### Play sound

`audio.playSound` · action

Plays a sound event.

- Settings: Sound (sound)
- Code: `audio.playSound(sound);`

### Set music

`audio.setMusic` · action

Changes the music.

- Settings: Music (music)
- Code: `audio.setMusic(music);`

### Stop music

`audio.stopMusic` · action

Fades the music out.

- Code: `audio.stopMusic();`

## Screens

### Show screen

`screen.show` · action

Shows a UI screen.

- Settings: Screen (screen)
- Code: `screen.show(screen);`

### Hide screen

`screen.hide` · action

Hides a UI screen.

- Settings: Screen (screen)
- Code: `screen.hide(screen);`

### Set screen text

`screen.setText` · action

Changes a text on a screen (a score, a hint).

- Settings: Screen (screen), Text element (string)
- Inputs: text (any)
- Code: `screen.setText(screen, element, text);`

## Cinematics

### Play cinematic

`cinematic.play` · action

Plays a cinematic. With Once, it plays only the first time.

- Settings: Cinematic (cinematic), Once (bool, optional)
- Code: `cinematic.play(cinematic, once);`

### Stop cinematic

`cinematic.stop` · action

Stops the cinematic that is playing.

- Code: `cinematic.stop();`

## Misc

### Log

`misc.log` · action

Writes a value to the console (handy while testing).

- Inputs: value (any)
- Code: `log(value);`

### Send event

`misc.emit` · action

Sends a custom event that “On custom event” nodes react to.

- Settings: Event name (event)
- Code: `emit(event);`

## Notes

### Comment

`note.comment` · note

A note on the canvas. It does nothing when the game runs.

- Settings: Text (string)

### Group

`note.group` · note

A labelled frame to group nodes on the canvas.

- Settings: Title (string), Width (number), Height (number)

## Health

### Damage

`health.damage` · action

Hurts the hero, a placed object or a neighbour, as a hit of this power and type would (armour and resistances count).

- Inputs: target (entity), amount (number), type (string), from (entity)
- Code: `health.damage(target, amount, type, from);`

### Heal

`health.heal` · action

Gives health back, never above its maximum (the hero: hearts).

- Inputs: target (entity), amount (number)
- Code: `health.heal(target, amount);`

### Set invulnerable

`health.setInvulnerable` · action

Nothing can hurt it while on (a shield spell, a cutscene, a boss between phases); off makes it take damage again.

- Inputs: target (entity), on (bool)
- Code: `health.setInvulnerable(target, on);`

## Saving

### Save game

`game.save` · action

Saves the game to a slot: where the hero is, what they carry, variables, and everything changed on the maps they visited. Use it for a save point, or after a big moment.

- Settings: Slot (number, optional)
- Code: `game.save(slot);`

### Load game

`game.load` · action

Loads a saved game: the maps, the hero and everything carried come back as they were saved. Empty slot: the newest save.

- Settings: Slot (number, optional)
- Code: `game.load(slot);`

### Unlock achievement

`game.unlockAchievement` · action

Unlocks one of the game’s achievements (Project › Progress) for this player: a 🏆 message shows, and it stays unlocked in every save and new game.

- Settings: Achievement id (string)
- Code: `game.unlockAchievement(achievement);`

### Finish game

`game.finish` · action

The player finished the game: it counts as finished (best scores are kept, new game plus opens on the title) and the title screen shows.

- Code: `game.finish();`

### Set checkpoint

`game.setCheckpoint` · action

From now on, Retry (after game over) and falling off the world bring the hero back to where they stand now.

- Code: `game.setCheckpoint();`

## Dialogue

### Start conversation

`dialogue.start` · action

Starts a conversation, as if the hero had talked to someone: its lines, choices and actions play in the game’s dialogue style. The hero stands still until it ends.

- Settings: Conversation (dialogue)
- Code: `dialogue.start(conversation);`

## Characters

### Give experience

`character.giveXp` · action

Gives the hero experience points. Reaching the next level (its sheet’s experience curve) says “Level up!”, plays its victory clip and fires On level up. Read them as the variables xp and level.

- Inputs: amount (number)
- Code: `hero.giveXp(amount);`

### Change outfit

`character.setOutfit` · action

The hero puts on one of the outfits on its sheet (Characters › Outfits): its look and the outfit’s stat bonuses change. Empty: its own clothes.

- Settings: Outfit name (string, optional)
- Code: `hero.setOutfit(outfit);`

### Switch hero

`character.switchHero` · action

Plays as the next hero of the party (Project › Party), as pressing H does.

- Code: `hero.switch();`

## Effects

### Play effect

`effect.play` · action

Plays an effect (sparks, fire, a level-up burst…) at the hero, or at an object, a neighbour or an effect placed on the map, by its name. A stream effect (fire, smoke) keeps going for its own length; for one that keeps going, place it on the map and use Start effect.

- Settings: Effect (effect), Where (string, optional)
- Code: `effects.play(effect, at);`

### Start effect

`effect.start` · action

Starts an effect placed on the map (by its name), as if it had been switched on: a stream keeps going, a burst plays on its interval, while the hero is near.

- Settings: Placed effect (string)
- Code: `effects.start(name);`

### Stop effect

`effect.stop` · action

Stops an effect placed on the map (by its name): no new particles; the ones flying finish their life.

- Settings: Placed effect (string)
- Code: `effects.stop(name);`

### Screen effect

`screen.effect` · action

Plays a screen effect: the camera shakes, the screen flashes or fades, the game freezes for a moment (hit-stop) or runs in slow motion. Use Fade to black, then Teleport, then Fade from black to move the hero out of sight.

- Settings: Screen effect (screenEffect)
- Code: `screen.effect(effect);`

### Set screen mood

`screen.mood` · action

Changes the mood of this map while the game plays: a colour grade over the view, dark edges (vignette), and something drifting across the screen. Going to another map brings back that map’s own mood.

- Settings: Colour (grade), Dark edges (0–1) (number), Drifting (drift), How much (0–1) (number)
- Code: `screen.mood(grade, vignette, drift, amount);`

### Clear the screen

`screen.clear` · action

Stops every screen effect at once (a fade to black that is holding, a shake, slow motion) and brings back the map’s own mood.

- Code: `screen.clear();`

## Lights

### Light on

`light.on` · action

Switches a light placed on the map on (by its name): it lights the bricks and characters around it again. An asset that gives light (a torch, a lamp) is switched by its name too.

- Settings: Light (string)
- Code: `lights.on(name);`

### Light off

`light.off` · action

Switches a light placed on the map off (by its name): the place around it goes as dark as the map.

- Settings: Light (string)
- Code: `lights.off(name);`

### Switch light

`light.toggle` · action

Switches a light placed on the map over: on if it was off, off if it was on (a lever that works both ways).

- Settings: Light (string)
- Code: `lights.toggle(name);`

### Set darkness

`light.darkness` · action

How dark this map is without its lights, while the game plays: 0 lit by its sky as usual, 1 pitch black (a cave as the torch goes out). Leaving the map puts it back.

- Settings: Darkness (0–1) (number)
- Code: `lights.darkness(amount);`
